definitions.full: H4890. mischaq מִשְׂחָק noun [masculine] object of derision , Hab 1:10 . [ שֵׂט ], שֵׁטִים see [ שׂוט ].

occurrences.englishText: Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.
